775: def retain_failed_documents(
776:     checklist: DocumentChecklist, previous: DocumentChecklist | None, failed_urls: set[str]
777: ) -> None:
778:     """An unreadable source cannot withdraw its previously read checklist.
779: 
780:     Successful reads, including an empty document list, replace their old
781:     items normally. No claim or verification date is refreshed here.
782:     """
783:     if previous is None or not failed_urls:
784:         return
785:     retained = False
786:     for field in ("admission_documents", "scholarship_documents"):
787:         current: list[DocumentItem] = getattr(checklist, field)
788:         present = {item.model_dump_json() for item in current}
789:         for item in getattr(previous, field):
790:             identity = item.model_dump_json()
791:             if item.source_url in failed_urls and identity not in present:
792:                 current.append(item)
793:                 present.add(identity)
794:                 retained = True
795:     if retained:
796:         checklist.completeness = "partial"
797:         _populate_actions(checklist)
